from build123d import *

outer_radius = 22.65          # ø45.3 shoulder (max diameter)
body_radius = 19.2            # ø38.4 main body
shoulder_len = 21.3           # shoulder length
body_len = 58.7               # body length (base -> shoulder face)
total_len = body_len + shoulder_len
bore_radius = 12.0            # central through hole (not printed)
slot_width = 6.0              # slot in shoulder face (not printed)
slot_depth = 4.0              # slot depth (not printed)
chamfer_dist = 2.0            # chamfer at tip end (not printed)
fillet_radius = 2.0           # fillet at base end (not printed)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, body_radius))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (body_len, body_radius))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (body_len, outer_radius))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (total_len, outer_radius))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (total_len, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part

# Central through hole along X axis
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(bore_radius, total_len + 20)

# Slot cut into shoulder face (face at x = body_len)
slot_box = Pos(body_len - slot_depth / 2, 0, 0) * Box(slot_depth, slot_width, outer_radius * 2)
solid_body = solid_body - slot_box

# Chamfer at tip end (outer rim at x = total_len)
tip_edges = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1:]
solid_body = chamfer(tip_edges, chamfer_dist)

# Fillet at base end (outer rim at x = 0)
base_edges = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.X)[:1]
solid_body = fillet(base_edges, fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_shaft_with_slot"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# Overall envelope
length = 80.0          # overall length (X)
height = 42.9          # overall height (Y)
depth = 34.8           # overall depth (Z)

# Profile control points
step_x = 20.0          # where the lower step ends
step_y = 20.0          # step height
arc_ctrl_x = 30.0      # rounded step-shoulder control point
arc_ctrl_y = 38.0
top_x = 70.0           # top edge end (tapered nose start)
nose_x = 80.0          # nose tip

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (nose_x, 0))                 # bottom edge
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (top_x, height))             # tapered nose edge
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (arc_ctrl_x, height))        # top edge
            arc = ThreePointArc(l3 @ 1, (arc_ctrl_x, arc_ctrl_y), (step_x, step_y))
            l4 = Line(arc @ 1, (0, step_y))                # step edge
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, 0))                      # left edge
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=depth)

part = p.part
part.name = "stepped_tapered_block"
export_step(part, "output.step")

outer_diameter = 80.0
inner_diameter = 64.9
width = 15.1
groove_diameter = 37.7
groove_width = 5.0
groove_offset = 4.0
pocket_width = 12.0
pocket_height = 8.0
pocket_depth = 3.0
chamfer_size = 0.8

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
groove_radius = groove_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, outer_radius), (width, outer_radius))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (width, inner_radius))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0, inner_radius))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, outer_radius))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part

groove = Pos(groove_offset + groove_width / 2.0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(groove_radius, groove_width)
solid_body = solid_body - groove

pocket = Pos(width - pocket_depth / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(pocket_depth, pocket_width, pocket_height)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
top_edges = top_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "ring_with_groove_and_pocket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

notch_w  = 10.0                   # notch width  (along X)
notch_d  = 5.0                    # notch depth  (into Y)
notch_x  = 15.0                   # notch centre, from the flat back face

part.name = "rounded_block"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, leg_height))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (inner_radius, leg_height))

lobe1_c = (lobe_radius, -hole_spacing / 2)   # lower lobe
lobe2_c = (lobe_radius,  hole_spacing / 2)   # upper lobe

# ---- locate the bridge / boss centre ----
boss_c = (overall_width - boss_radius, overall_length - lobe_radius)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            # lower lobe arc  (leftmost point -> bottom -> right side)
            ThreePointArc((0, lobe1_c[1]), (0, -overall_length / 2),
                          (lobe_radius * 2, lobe1_c[1]))
            # bridge: right side of lower lobe -> boss centre
            Line((lobe_radius * 2, lobe1_c[1]), boss_c)
            # boss arc  (rightmost point -> top -> left side)
            ThreePointArc(boss_c,
                          (overall_width, boss_c[1]),
                          (boss_c[0], overall_length))
            # bridge: left side of boss -> upper lobe
            Line((boss_c[0], overall_length),

            # upper lobe arc  (right side -> top -> leftmost point)
            ThreePointArc((lobe_radius * 2, lobe2_c[1]),
                          (0, overall_length / 2),
                          (0, lobe2_c[1]))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid = p.part

    overall_width - leg_thick, overall_height - leg_thick, overall_depth)

             -overall_height / 2 + leg_thick + pocket_width / 2,

from build123d import *

overall_length = 80.0          # axial length of the part
outer_radius   = 36.6 / 2.0    # large end radius  (36.6 diameter)
step_radius    = 23.2 / 2.0    # reduced section radius (ø23.2)
step_length    = 20.0          # length of the reduced section
fillet_radius  = 2.0           # blend between the two diameters
chamfer_dist   = 1.0           # break edges at the small end face

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))                       # large end face
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, overall_length - step_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (step_radius, overall_length - step_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (step_radius, overall_length))           # small end face
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, overall_length))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part

# Fillet the internal corner where the two diameters meet
inner_edges = [e for e in solid_body.edges()
               if abs(e.center().Y - (overall_length - step_length)) < 1.0]
solid_body = fillet(inner_edges, fillet_radius)

# Chamfer the small-end face edges to break the sharp corners
top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_dist)

part = solid_body

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
outer_diameter = 76.6          # overall flower diameter
thickness = 7.0               # plate thickness
bore_diameter = 31.5          # central through hole
rib_outer_diameter = 43.6     # raised annular rib outer diameter
rib_height = 2.0              # rib height above the plate face
hole_diameter = 3.5           # 9x blind holes
hole_depth = 1.7              # blind hole depth
chamfer_size = 0.5            # chamfer on outer profile edges

# ---- Petal geometry (five-petal flower) ----
petal_length = outer_diameter / 2.0          # 38.3
petal_width = 20.0                          # across the lobe
inner_radius = bore_diameter / 2.0          # 15.75

def polar(pt):
    return (pt[0] * math.cos(pt[1]) - pt[1] * math.sin(pt[1]),
            pt[0] * math.sin(pt[1]) + pt[1] * math.cos(pt[1]))

def petal_points(angle_deg):
    a = math.radians(angle_deg)
    tip = polar((petal_length, 0))
    left = polar((petal_length * 0.6, -petal_width / 2.0))
    right = polar((petal_length * 0.6, petal_width / 2.0))
    root = polar((inner_radius, 0))
    return [root, left, tip, right]

# ---- Build the five-petal outline ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            pts = []
            for i in range(5):
                ang = i * 72.0
                pts.extend(petal_points(ang))
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# ---- Central through bore ----
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2.0, thickness * 2)

# ---- Raised annular rib on top face ----
rib = Pos(0, thickness / 2.0 + rib_height / 2.0, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(rib_outer_diameter / 2.0, rib_height)
solid_body = solid_body + rib

# ---- Nine blind holes on the rib, equally spaced ----
hole_radius = rib_outer_diameter / 2.0
for i in range(9):
    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 9)
    hx = hole_radius * math.cos(ang)
    hz = hole_radius * math.sin(ang)
    hole = Pos(hx, thickness / 2.0 + rib_height - hole_depth / 2.0, hz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2.0, hole_depth)
    solid_body = solid_body - hole

# ---- Chamfer outer profile edges (edges running along thickness) ----
y_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
solid_body = chamfer(y_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "five_petal_flower_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
outer_diameter = 76.6          # overall span across the five petals
thickness = 7.0                # plate thickness

ring_outer_dia = 43.6          # bolt circle for the 9 holes
ring_hole_dia = 3.5            # 9x hole diameter
ring_hole_depth = 4.0          # blind depth from the front face
chamfer_size = 0.5

# ---- Five-petal outer profile (polar r = R + a*cos(5 theta)) ----
R = outer_diameter / 2.0
a = 12.0                      # petal amplitude (qualitative, not printed)
pts = [(R + a * math.cos(5 * t), t) for t in [i * 0.1 for i in range(101)]]

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid = p.part

# ---- Central through bore ----
solid = solid - Pos(0, thickness/2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter/2, thickness)

# ---- 9 blind holes on the ring ----
ring_r = ring_outer_dia / 2.0
for i in range(9):
    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 9)
    px = ring_r * math.cos(ang)
    pz = ring_r * math.sin(ang)
    solid = solid - Pos(px, thickness - ring_hole_depth/2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(ring_hole_dia/2, ring_hole_depth)

# ---- Chamfer all edges ----
solid = chamfer(solid.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = solid
part.name = "five_petal_flange"
export_step(part, "output.step")

hole_offset_z = 32.7      # from bottom face

outer_x = overall_width               # tip of arms

outer_y = (overall_depth + cheek_thk) / 2.0
inner_z = (overall_height - arm_thk) / 2.0
outer_z = (overall_height + arm_thk) / 2.0

bottom_arm = Pos((inner_x + outer_x) / 2.0, 0, -outer_z + arm_thk / 2.0) * Box(arm_len, overall_depth, arm_thk)
result = result + top_arm + bottom_arm

body_length = 80.0          # overall length (X)
body_width = 25.0           # overall width  (Y)
body_height = 29.6          # overall height (Z)
fillet_radius = 4.4         # 4x R4.4 vertical corner fillets
boss_radius = 10.35         # ø20.7 bosses
boss_length = 15.6          # boss projection length
hole_diameter = 16.3        # 1x ⌀16.3 through holes
set_screw_dia = 3.0         # 1x ⌀3.0 set screw hole
set_screw_depth = 5.9
set_screw_offset = 3.7      # from left end
set_screw_y = 12.6          # from front face (center of 25 width)

# ---------------- base body ----------------
solid = Box(body_length, body_width, body_height)
solid = fillet(solid.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)

# ---------------- bosses ----------------

solid = solid + Pos(0, body_width/2 + boss_length/2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_length)
# right-end boss (+X face), axis along X
solid = solid + Pos(body_length/2 + boss_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_length)

from build123d import *

plate_width = 80.0
plate_height = 69.2
plate_thickness = 6.0
rib_width = 30.0
rib_height = 40.0
rib_depth = 8.0
rib_offset_x = 10.0
hole_diameter = 5.5

corner_rib_depth = 8.0

rib = Pos(rib_center_x, plate_thickness/2 + rib_depth/2, 0) * Box(rib_width, rib_depth, rib_height)

corner_positions = [
    (-plate_width/2 + corner_offset + corner_rib_width/2, -plate_height/2 + corner_offset + corner_rib_width/2),
    ( plate_width/2 - corner_offset - corner_rib_width/2, -plate_height/2 + corner_offset + corner_rib_width/2),

    ( plate_width/2 - corner_offset - corner_rib_width/2,  plate_height/2 - corner_offset - corner_rib_width/2),
]

    Pos(cx, plate_thickness/2 + corner_rib_depth/2, cz) * Box(corner_rib_width, corner_rib_depth, corner_rib_width)

neck_radius    = neck_diameter / 2.0
tip_diameter   = 20.5          # ø20.5  small end
tip_radius     = tip_diameter / 2.0

# ---- Axial stations (from SECTION A–A) ----
z_body_end = 52.6              # body -> neck step
z_neck_end = 62.6              # neck -> tip step
z_tip_end  = overall_length    # 80.0

# ---- Flange (rectangular mounting foot at the small end) ----
flange_width  = 34.6           # 34.6 across the flange
flange_height = 20.5           # 20.5 across the flange
flange_thick  = 7.7            # 7.7  flange thickness
flange_hole_d = 7.7            # 1x ⌀7.7 through hole
flange_hole_x = 11.2           # hole centre offset from flange centreline

# ---- Knurl grooves (shallow, evenly spaced around the body) ----
knurl_depth = 1.0              # radial depth of each groove
knurl_pitch = 5.0              # axial pitch between grooves
knurl_count = int((z_body_end - 10.0) / knurl_pitch)

# ---- Small-end set-screw hole ----
set_screw_d = 0.5              # 1x ⌀0.5
set_screw_x = 14.1             # centre offset from end centreline

# =====================================================================
#  Revolved body profile (XZ plane, revolved about the Z axis)
# =====================================================================
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (body_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (body_radius, z_body_end))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (neck_radius, z_body_end))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (neck_radius, z_neck_end))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (tip_radius, z_neck_end))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (tip_radius, z_tip_end))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, z_tip_end))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:

            l1 = Line((-flange_width/2, 0), (flange_width/2, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (flange_width/2, flange_thick))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (-flange_width/2, flange_thick))

            l1 = Line((0, 0), (shank_diameter / 2, 0))                       # tip

from build123d import *

# ---------- Overall envelope ----------
width      = 80.0     # overall width  (X)
height     = 46.1     # overall height (Z)
depth      = 24.0     # base plate thickness (Y)
boss_len   = 60.0     # boss projection length
boss_dia   = 17.2     # boss diameter
hole_dia   = 12.3     # through hole diameter
gusset_thk = 4.0      # gusset thickness
gusset_h   = 36.6     # gusset height
fillet_r   = 1.0      # gusset edge fillet

# ---------- Base plate ----------
base = Box(width, depth, height)

# ---------- Bosses (cylinders along Y) ----------
boss_r = boss_dia / 2
boss = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(boss_r, boss_len)

x_off = width / 3.0
z_off = height / 2.0 - boss_dia / 2.0 - 5.0
bosses = (Pos(-x_off, depth/2, z_off) * boss +
          Pos(0,      depth/2, z_off) * boss +
          Pos(x_off,  depth/2, z_off) * boss)

result = base + bosses

# ---------- Through holes ----------
hole_r = hole_dia / 2
hole = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_r, boss_len)

         Pos(0,      depth/2, z_off) * hole +
         Pos(x_off,  depth/2, z_off) * hole)

        make_face()
    extrude(amount=gusset_thk)

gusset = gp.part
gusset = fillet(gusset.edges().filter_by(Axis.X), fillet_r)

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Overall envelope (from drawing) ----
flange_diameter = 80.0          # ø80  flange
flange_thickness = 13.8         # 13.8 flange thickness
body_diameter = 49.7            # ø49.7 upper body
body_height = 60.7              # 60.7 overall height
bore_diameter = 27.6            # 1x ⌀27.6 through bore
hole_diameter = 6.9             # 6x ⌀6.9 flange holes
hole_margin = 7.4               # 7.4 edge margin for hole pattern
fillet_radius = 2.0             # small top-edge fillet (not printed)

# ---- Side slot (60.7 A/F across flange, 7.6 deep) ----
slot_width = 60.7
slot_depth = 7.6
slot_length = 40.0              # along the flange face

# ---- Derived locations ----
hole_radius = (flange_diameter / 2) - hole_margin   # 32.6
hole_angles = [0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300]
hole_points = [(hole_radius * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
               hole_radius * math.sin(math.radians(a))) for a in hole_angles]

# ---- Build ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (flange_diameter / 2, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (flange_diameter / 2, flange_thickness))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (body_diameter / 2, flange_thickness))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (body_diameter / 2, body_height))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, body_height))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid = p.part

# Central through bore
solid = solid - Pos(0, 0, body_height / 2) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, body_height + 10)

# Six flange holes
for x, y in hole_points:
    solid = solid - Pos(x, y, body_height / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, body_height + 10)

# Side slot cut through the flange
slot_box = Pos(flange_diameter / 2 - slot_depth / 2, 0, flange_thickness / 2) * Box(slot_depth, slot_width, slot_length)
solid = solid - slot_box

# Small fillet on the top outer edge
top_edges = solid.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
solid = fillet(top_edges, fillet_radius)

part = solid
part.name = "flanged_body_with_slot"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
overall_height = 80.0          # 80  (overall height)
overall_width  = 44.8          # 44.8 A/F (overall width, across flats)
leg_length     = 26.9          # 26.9 (leg length / depth of part)
leg_thickness  = 13.1          # 13.1 (vertical leg thickness)
inner_radius   = 13.1          # inner corner radius (matches leg thickness)
pocket_width   = 12.0          # pocket width  (11.2 + 0.8)
pocket_length  = 20.0          # pocket length (26.9 - 6.9)
pocket_offset  = 15.0          # pocket offset from inner edge

# ---- L-profile in the X-Y plane ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (leg_length, 0))                       # bottom edge
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (leg_length, inner_radius))            # up to arc start
            a1 = RadiusArc(l2 @ 1, (leg_thickness, inner_radius), inner_radius)  # inner corner arc
            l3 = Line(a1 @ 1, (leg_thickness, overall_height))       # up the vertical leg
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, overall_height))                   # top edge
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, 0))                                # left edge
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=overall_width)                                   # extrude to overall width

solid_body = p.part

# ---- Rectangular pocket on the horizontal leg ----
pocket = Pos(leg_length / 2, pocket_offset + pocket_width / 2, overall_width / 2) * Box(
    pocket_length, pocket_width, overall_width
)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket

part = solid_body
part.name = "L_bracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

lower_x = overall_width / 2.0 - lobe_radius

import math

hex_height = 31.7                      # body height

# ---- Base flange (bottom) ----
flange_radius = 40.0                   # outer radius of the flange
flange_thickness = 26.4               # flange height
slot_width = 10.0                     # radial slot width
slot_depth = 12.0                     # slot depth from outer edge
slot_count = 12                       # evenly spaced slots
chamfer_size = 2.6                    # chamfer on bottom outer edge

# Hexagonal prism (centred in XY, bottom at Z=0)
with BuildPart() as p:

solid_body = solid_body + flange

for i in range(slot_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / slot_count)
    px = slot_r * math.cos(angle)
    py = slot_r * math.sin(angle)
    slot = Pos(px, py, flange_thickness / 2) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, flange_thickness)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot
